---
name: Documented conformance concern
about: Raise a fact-based concern about a public SDAF conformance claim
title: "[Conformance] "
labels: ""

---

## Public claim

Provide the exact public claim or a precise summary, together with a stable source or URL.

Do not include private correspondence, personal data or confidential material.

## Claiming party

Identify the organization, project, product or service only to the extent necessary to evaluate the public claim.

## SDAF version claimed

Identify the SDAF version referenced. If no version is stated, write:

`No SDAF version identified in the public claim.`

## Declared scope

Record the publicly declared:

- activity, implementation, product, service or result;
- organizational and system boundaries;
- applicable SDAF requirements;
- exclusions;
- conditions;
- assurance status; and
- validity period.

If any of these are absent, identify them as not publicly stated.

## Applicable conformance requirements

Identify the relevant requirements from Annex IV-C, including IV-C.8 where applicable.

## Documented discrepancy

Describe the precise difference between:

1. the public claim or disclosed evidence; and
2. the applicable published SDAF requirement.

Use factual and technically verifiable language.

## Available evidence

Provide links to public records, declarations, reports or other evidence that can be independently reviewed.

Distinguish:

- documented fact;
- reasonable inference;
- missing information; and
- unresolved question.

## Materiality

Explain how the discrepancy could affect:

- the scope of the claim;
- evidence integrity;
- decision validity;
- conformance;
- assurance;
- stakeholder interpretation; or
- continued use of the claim.

## Clarification sought

State the specific clarification, correction or evidence that would resolve the concern.

## Prior contact

If relevant, state whether clarification has already been requested through an appropriate channel. Do not reproduce confidential communications.

## Conflict-of-interest disclosure

Identify any relevant relationship, competitive interest or other circumstance that a reviewer should understand.

## Submission checks

- [ ] The concern relates to a public SDAF conformance claim.
- [ ] I identified the applicable published requirement.
- [ ] I used factual language and avoided speculation about motives, competence, ethics or legality.
- [ ] I distinguished absent evidence from evidence of nonconformance.
- [ ] I have not included personal, confidential, privileged or security-sensitive information.
- [ ] I understand that opening an issue does not establish that the claim is nonconforming.
